messages:
Sam W: Taking primary for the night (21:00–05:00 PT). Quick pre-pass: can folks confirm PagerDuty primary/secondary, AWS switch-role for oncall, and Grafana dash access for incidents/runtime? I'll be offline 02:30–03:00 PT for a short window, Ira will be backup then.

Dani P: @Sam W noted. I'm secondary until 23:30, then Ira becomes secondary. I just checked PD: policy 'redwood-infra' shows you as Primary, Dani as Secondary.

Oncall Bot: Incident INC-20987 created — alert: 95th latency spike on runtime-1. Bridge: https://meet.example/bridge/INC-20987 — pinned.

Ira K: Sam, did a quick AWS role check from my laptop:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall --role-session-name oncall-check
# returns temporary creds (AccessKeyId/Secret/SessionToken)
```
No failures. If you get AccessDenied, ping me and I'll open a JIT. Grafana: you should have access to org 'redwood-prod' -> dashboards 'incidents' and 'runtime-qps'. If you hit SSO loop, clear cookies or try private window.

Mina (Ops Lead): Also confirm you can SUDO on the jumpbox (jjump-ops) for quick escalation. If you don't have it, request JIT here: https://idm.redwood/internal/jit-requests?purpose=oncall — approvals are fast for oncall role.

Sam W: Doing checks now. PD web shows me primary for infra and customer-ops; thanks @Dani. Ran the AWS command, got creds back, test assume-role succeeded. Grafana loads dashboards but I can't edit annotations (I only need view during night).

Dani P: view-only for annotations is fine for a night shift. If you need to annotate a mitigation step, DM me and I can add the note. :thumbsup:

Ira K: Small note — if you need to escalate to dedicated capacity owners, PD escalation policy 'dedicated-capacity-oncall' goes to pagers followed by Ops Lead. Keep the incident tag 'capacity' in PD so routing works.

Sam W: Good call. Also adding runbook links here for quick reference:
- Oncall access/runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-access
- Incident triage quick checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-triage
- Grafana incident dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/redwood-prod/incidents

Mina (Ops Lead): One more: if a page requires customer-notify, follow the notif playbook (internal) and loop CS via #support. Template lives in runbook above.

Sam W: All set — PD primary confirmed, AWS role good, Grafana view OK. I'll hand over to Ira at 02:30 PT (Ira you're the backup then). If any permissions fail while I'm offline, call/text me. Passing baton. :white_check_mark:
